editorial:
You're dropped right back into the frozen world with Manny, Sid, and Diego, but this time the stakes get bigger when Sid stumbles into a hidden underground world full of dinosaurs. The gang has to rescue him, and along the way they meet Buck, a one-eyed weasel who knows the dangerous new world like the back of his paw. It's a fun, colorful adventure that keeps the heart of the first two movies while adding a whole new playground of giant creatures and wild action. Manny and Ellie are also expecting a baby, which adds a sweet family touch.

The animation looks great, especially the lush dinosaur world, and the action scenes move fast without losing the humor. Buck steals the show with his crazy energy, and the heart of the story still lands well. On the downside, some jokes feel a little repetitive, and the story can feel crowded with so many characters. Still, kids and families will have a blast, and it's a solid pick for a cozy movie night. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Buck leads the herd through the dinosaur world to rescue Sid, who has been captured by a T-Rex mother after taking her eggs. The mother T-Rex eventually warms up to Sid, and the herd escapes back to the surface. Buck decides to stay behind in the dinosaur world. Manny and Ellie welcome their baby, a girl named Peaches, and the herd celebrates their growing family together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures with dinosaurs and heart.
